territories.name: Substantial kitchen truth
territories.concept: A substantial kitchen field manual: stock truth is framed with the same bold, direct energy as the BulkBite customer brand, while dense work stays calm and legible.
territories.sharedVisualGrammar: Ink structural fields, warm-paper work surfaces, sharp frames, large numeric evidence, compact operational labels, and one orange action signal per screen.
territories.alignmentRhythm: A twelve-column desktop grid and reduced mobile flow use strong left axes, 8 px spacing increments, dense work zones, and generous separation around decisions.

references.source: BulkBite design system.txt and the public bulkbite.co.za HTML/CSS
references.evidence: Anton display type, #101010 ink, #F5F0E6 warm paper, #FF5A1F orange, large quantities, direct copy, and sharp rectangular framing.
references.principleToBorrow: Use scale and contrast to make the important quantity and next action obvious within seconds.
references.doNotCopy: Do not copy public sales-page content, food photography, or marketing-only interactions into the kitchen application.

references.source: BulkBite Poster Campaign: Final Creative Brief
references.evidence: Campaign compositions use one dominant statement, restrained orange emphasis, short supporting copy, and one tested action.
references.principleToBorrow: Each operational screen should have one dominant job and one clear posting action.
references.doNotCopy: Do not place poster slogans, tracked QR advertising, or unverified appetite claims in operational workflows.

territories.typography: Anton in uppercase owns short page titles, major quantities, and decisive state labels. System sans owns instructions, forms, tables, metadata, and long reading.
territories.colorMaterial: Ink is the structural canvas, warm paper and white hold work, orange marks the primary action or active state, amber is reserved for money, and muted grey carries low-priority context.
territories.geometryLines: Rectangular panels, visible one-pixel rules, offset bands, and square controls. Avoid excessive rounding, floating pills, glossy depth, and gradients.
territories.imagery: Use the supplied wordmark or symbol assets only. Operational meaning uses simple line icons and textual evidence. Food imagery is unnecessary in the stock app.
territories.spacingDensity: Dashboard claims receive breathing room; forms and tables become compact where repeated entry benefits from density. Touch targets remain at least 44 px.
territories.composition: Every workflow moves from current state to evidence, entry, review, and one explicit posting action. Mobile stacks this order without hiding units or status.
territories.motion: Fast state confirmation and short directional transitions. Reduced motion renders the final hierarchy immediately, with no information depending on movement.
territories.systemCompatibility: Desyium theme tokens own color, type, radius, spacing treatment, motion policy, and prohibitions. Frappe UI component owners supply operational controls through generated System exports. Blocks own workflow composition.
territories.projectTranslationBoundary: References supply evidence and principles only; the approved project theme must be translated from this project's brief and must not copy a reference identity.
